decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated the options focusing on brand reputation, rating quality, and portability. I excluded several products that were actually accessories like cases and charging cables. Within the speakers, the JBL brand stood out for its high ratings. I considered the premium Charge 5 and the budget-friendly Go 3, alongside strong generic competitors like Raymate and EDUPLINK. I ultimately chose the JBL Go 3 because it offers a high rating of 4.7, excellent portability, and IP67 waterproof protection from a trusted audio brand at a very competitive price point.
